heading: The Marginarium: how it was made
first_line: Paint by Moonlight turns a photo into a paint-by-number painting on your device. The Marginarium tells how Paul built it with AI agents.
content_why: One passage and one picture per chapter keeps the page short and lets the painting stay the hero, with the full stories left for the app.
avoid: Avoid pasting the full chapters or the pet pictures beside the painting, which would crowd it and make the page overstay.
